name: Wartime Standard Type B cargo ship

reference.source: lengthM, beamM from the English Wikipedia article 'Japanese cargo ship Mimasaka Maru (1944)', one of 18 Wartime Standard Type B ships laid down 1943-44: 4,667 GRT, 112.00 m, 15.80 m beam, 9.10 m draught, read 2026-09-20. deckHeightM (6 m) is the escort's figure reused as an ESTIMATE; freeboard is not sourced. maxSpeedMps (12 kn) and turnRateRadPerS are ESTIMATES for the class. hullHp (240 = two bombs, six rockets, or one bomb and three rockets) is a gameplay choice (Plan 6b).
